name: Tenneco Clean Air India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2018, Tenneco Clean Air India Limited is a subsidiary of Tenneco Inc., a global leader in designing and manufacturing clean air and powertrain products for automotive applications.[1]
keyPoints: Business Ownership[1] The company is part of the U.S.-based Tenneco Group, a global Tier-1 supplier to major automotive OEMs and the aftermarket.
pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 42.0%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 100.0%
cons: Stock is trading at 11.6 times its book value
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -15.0%
